note: Name-to-ruleId mapping for the blind manifests (daedalus-sealed/v1.3-blind/blind-out). Written before scoring. basis: 'library-alias' = a template name the rule library documents for that id (Docs/v1.3-reference-notes.md §4 for hexagonal; the DDD preset composes the hexagonal layering templates); 'tier-row' = the sealed rule-tiers.md row name, resolved through src/scoring-engine/rule-tiers.ts DDD_RULE_TIERS (integration notes, DDD wiring); 'guessed' = an OTHER construct mapped by judgement; 'unmapped' = no compared rule states the construct. Plain FF-xxx ids map to themselves and are not listed. Ids outside a style's compared rules (FF-C04, FF-SO01, and FF-S02/FF-S04/FF-P02 under ddd) are kept but scored as 'unscored'.

mapping.name: DDD repository only for aggregate roots
DDD domain events defined in the domain
DDD application services hold no business rules
OTHER: shared code outside every declared layer and context
mapping.note: The construct (a file in no declared context root and no declared outside-context path) is the condition of FF-DS01 bounded-context-modules, which has no row of its own in rule-tiers.md, so the annotator could not name it. The annotator filed it advisory; the tool tiers FF-DS01 blocking (an open author decision, integration notes).

mapping.name: OTHER: repository implementation depends on an application DTO
mapping.note: An infrastructure file importing an application file is FF-S01 if the nestjs layer list is a dependency order. The annotator listed FF-S01 in alsoMatches but doubted that reading (confidence low, filed advisory).

mapping.name: OTHER: public API publishes an application service; consumer bypasses its ACL
mapping.note: The annotator states that the literal import satisfies bounded-context isolation. The remaining construct (a published service, a bypassed ACL) is stated by no compared rule.

mapping.name: OTHER: lower-layer type exposed through the business API
mapping.note: No compared layered rule covers an API signature exposing a lower-layer type.

mapping.name: OTHER: cross-module import not via module exports
mapping.note: Appears in alsoMatches only. NestJS module-export discipline is not a compared rule.

policies.alsoMatches: Headline (expanded): each mapped id in a finding's ruleId and alsoMatches is an expected finding with that finding's file and target; duplicates collapse. Sensitivity (primary): only the finding's own ruleId.
policies.targets: A blind target of the form 'X (via Y)' is read as X.
policies.FF-S02: Cycle findings match on the unordered file pair, because the blind annotator did not use the template's canonical rotation.
